name: Viseron
description: Viseron is a self-hosted, local only NVR and AI Computer Vision software

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-viseron application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-viseron
  # The `big-bear-viseron` service definition
  big-bear-viseron:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-viseron
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: roflcoopter/viseron:3.7.0@sha256:73ed6822f4878f2eb52b423e48d6077dbbc8c6aeb6d7636d5452b5c1271145e3
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Shared memory size
    shm_size: "1024mb"
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/segments:/segments
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/snapshots:/snapshots
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/thumbnails:/thumbnails
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/event/clips:/event_clips
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config:/config
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 8888 of the host to port 8888 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:8888"
    # Environment variables
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
